label: Base demonstrativa acadêmica: indicadores complementares estimados, não dados reais de mercado.

formulas.annual_maintenance_cost: price_brl * annual_maintenance_price_fraction, ROUND_HALF_UP to money_quantum; BRL/year

limitations: 2.5% and 10% are declared experimental assumptions, not fitted market estimates.
Neutral scores express absence of evidence, not average safety, quality or reliability.
Identical recorded prices produce identical complementary components regardless of brand, model or collection group.
Legacy price and consumption retain their original provenance; this method does not make them observed.
Missing/nonpositive price cannot produce maintenance. Missing consumption cannot enable activation.
Only complementary values are projected. Legacy stored values remain unchanged.
